requirements.title: Construct execution establishes selector-to-associate-name association
requirements.definition: Execution of SELECT RANK or SELECT TYPE establishes association between the selector and associate name. Execution of ASSOCIATE or CHANGE TEAM establishes association between each selector and corresponding associate name.

pending.associate-establishes-selector-associati: Existing owners doc/catalogues/purpose_and_form_of_the_associate_construct_11_1_3_1.json and doc/catalogues/execution_of_the_associate_construct_11_1_3_2.json supply ASSOCIATE form/execution. Variable-selector two-way plan: with integer selector x=1, ASSOCIATE(a => x); associate-to-selector sets a=42 and immediately checks x=42; selector-to-associate then sets x=77 inside the construct and immediately checks a=77.
pending.select-type-establishes-selector-associa: Existing owner doc/catalogues/execution_of_the_select_type_construct_11_1_11_2.json (S11.1.11.2-002) supplies SELECT TYPE execution. Variable-selector two-way plan: selector poly has dynamic type child and component v=1; in TYPE IS(child), associate-to-selector sets a%v=42 and checks poly%v=42; selector-to-associate sets poly%v=77 inside the block and checks a%v=77.
pending.select-rank-establishes-selector-associa: Existing owner doc/catalogues/execution_of_the_select_rank_construct_11_1_10_2.json (S11.1.10.2-001) supplies SELECT RANK execution. Variable-selector two-way plan: rank-one selector x starts [1,2]; in RANK(1), associate-to-selector sets a(2)=42 and checks x(2)=42; selector-to-associate sets x(2)=77 inside the block and checks a(2)=77.
pending.change-team-association-out-of-scope: Existing owner doc/catalogues/execution_of_a_change_team_construct_11_1_5_2.json covers CHANGE TEAM execution. CHANGE TEAM selector association is team/coarray-dependent here, so it is out of scope by user decision; no single-image two-way runtime plan is registered.

requirements.title: Allocatable and pointer selectors in ASSOCIATE or SELECT TYPE have required allocation or association status
requirements.definition: In ASSOCIATE or SELECT TYPE, an allocatable selector shall be allocated and a pointer selector shall be associated.

pending.pointer-selector-must-be-associated: Positive control pointer p=>target t where t=1 enters ASSOCIATE(a=>p), assigns a=42, and expects t=42; a mutation nullifies p before the construct without claiming a required diagnostic.

requirements.title: Associate names for allocatable and pointer selectors associate with the selected object or target without selector attributes
requirements.definition: For an allocated allocatable selector, the associate name is associated with the data object and does not have ALLOCATABLE. For an associated pointer selector, the associate name is associated with the target and does not have POINTER.

pending.allocatable-associate-name-no-allocatabl: Allocated integer x=1 enters ASSOCIATE(a=>x); source-control confirms a is used as a scalar data object and allocation inquiry on a is not part of this fixture.
pending.pointer-associate-name-target: With p=>t and t=1, ASSOCIATE(a=>p) assigns a=42 and observes t=42, then assigns t=77 and observes a=77, proving association with the target.
pending.pointer-associate-name-no-pointer: With p=>t, source-control uses a only as the nonpointer associated object; pointer status inquiries are reserved for p and not for associate name a.

requirements.title: Construct association is with the selector object for variables and with a pre-evaluated value for expressions or vector-subscript sections
requirements.definition: For a variable selector other than an array section with a vector subscript, association is with the data object specified by the selector; otherwise association is with the value of the selector expression evaluated before block execution.

pending.variable-selector-object-association: ASSOCIATE(a=>x) with x=1 gives the exact variable-selector object plan: associate-to-selector sets a=42 and checks x=42; selector-to-associate then sets x=77 inside the construct and checks a=77.
pending.expression-selector-value-association: Expression selectors are associated with the value under 19.5.1.6 p3. ASSOCIATE(a=>x+1) with x=5 records a=6, then x=100 and a remains exact 6. Non-definability of expression associate names is owned by existing doc/catalogues/purpose_and_form_of_the_associate_construct_11_1_3_1.json C1101 and doc/catalogues/other_attributes_of_associate_names_11_1_3_3.json S11.1.3.3-005; assignment to a is not attempted here.
pending.vector-subscript-section-value-associati: Vector-subscript array sections are associated with the value under 19.5.1.6 p3. With arr=[10,20,30] and idx=[3,1], ASSOCIATE(a=>arr(idx)) records a=[30,10], then arr(3)=99 and a remains [30,10]. Non-definability is owned by existing doc/catalogues/purpose_and_form_of_the_associate_construct_11_1_3_1.json C1101 and doc/catalogues/other_attributes_of_associate_names_11_1_3_3.json S11.1.3.3-005.

Non-definability of expression associate names is owned by existing doc/catalogues/purpose_and_form_of_the_associate_construct_11_1_3_1.json C1101 and doc/catalogues/other_attributes_of_associate_names_11_1_3_3.json S11.1.3.3-005.

requirements.title: Associate names remain associated through the block, provide access, and terminate at construct completion
requirements.definition: Each associate name remains associated with its selector throughout the executed block, the selector is known by and accessed by the associate name inside the block, and construct completion terminates the association.

pending.associate-name-remains-associated-throug: Inside ASSOCIATE(a=>x), set a=42, execute a conditional block and a DO loop, then read a into observed; exact observed=42 and x=42 prove association persists through the executed block.
pending.selector-accessed-by-associate-name: ASSOCIATE(a=>x) with x=1 reads a into observed=-777 before any write and expects exact 1, proving access by the associate name.
pending.construct-association-terminates-on-comp: Host integer a=-777 and selector x=1; inside ASSOCIATE(a=>x) set a=42, after END ASSOCIATE assign host a=99 and verify x remains 42 and host a=99, proving the associate binding ended.
